selection: Chosen after development-only CLS and missing-policy diagnostics. Earlier patch-method test and background results were exposed; these are reused evaluation sets, not a new independent confirmatory cohort.
representation: Same pinned DINO ViT-B/16 CLS on full-frame subject-isolated RGB; fill 128; float32 before official Resize; same frozen automatic per-variant scoring masks.
aggregation: All-pairs cosine among frames with subject masks, clamp negative cosine at zero.
missing_rule: At least two subject frames: conditional CLS score. Fewer than two: recorded Official score. Runtime failures never silently fall back.
analysis: Keep complete denominators, runtime errors and fallback counts. Compare paired prompt-cluster bootstrap at seed 20260920 with 10000 draws. Report all background positions and subject responses. Do not change settings after followup results.
user_localization_tolerance: Roughly capture the subject's main parts; minor boundary error does not block experiments. No measured contour IoU claim.
